plausibility_notes: Artie faces a concrete threatened resignation; Anne loses education funds; Vincent faces public humiliation. These motives are credible but no one yet connects to poisoning.
Barb authorizes camera removal and suppresses immediate public notice of a stolen poison bottle. Donor instructions explain both actions, without establishing innocence.
Dada has a canceled collapse effect and grievance over stolen credit. Obvious theatrical red herring, but no assumption that this clears murder.
Poison cabinet forced at 6:12; donor camera disconnected 6:29; mounting hold 6:35/37; toast scheduled6:49. It is possible to steal poison long before preparing the glass.
Every guest receives miniature fragrance, reducing evidential value of merely seeing a small bottle. Distinctive star glass and shared punch set up a targeted glass mechanism.
A hazardous poison retained in a normal preparation cabinet seems lax; forced entry needs physical investigation and opportunity evidence.

Many documentary annotations anticipate specific deductions and insist on distinctions (lighting/security, replica/original, gift/service). Useful clarity but unusually explanatory for authentic paperwork.
Jordan has normal key access but forced entry could either imply another thief or be staged; the signed report alone cannot decide that.
